statement: Holdout unicorn seals (Mohenjo-daro and Harappa) coded Bull1:W in ICIT are larger than other unicorn seals with the same text length (capped at 8) at the same site. Size = sqrt(horizontal mm x vertical mm) from the ICIT export (sha256 above; 0 = missing). Statistic: within site x length cells, mean log size of W seals minus other unicorn seals, weighted by cell size, over cells containing both. Null: W labels permuted within cells. One-sided (greater). The meaning of the ICIT code 'W' is not published; it co-occurs mostly with the stand code 'SAF'. Exploration: +24.9% (p 0.002; 208 W seals; results/two_kinds_of_seal_text.md, results/composite_tablets.md context). Checked not to depend on inch-recorded sizes (+22% and +11%). Planned support: about 50 W seals, from the exploration count and the 80/20 split, not from the holdout. If support is below the project minimum of 15, the result is reported as below planned support. Benjamini-Hochberg across all confirmatory tests.
author: Erin (RN-Top); prepared by Claude
